title: MovimientoInventario
description: One row of the Permanent Inventory Record in Physical Units (Format 12.1, RS 234-2006/SUNAT; 19 fields). CU-14. Rules R-60 to R-66.

periodo.description: Field 1: AAAAMM00 of the movement date (R-60).

correlativoAsiento.description: Field 3: A = opening, M = movement, C = closing.

codigoEstablecimiento.description: Field 4: SUNAT annex establishment code; 0000 = registered address. Same value as the CPE cbc:AddressTypeCode (R-64).

codigoExistencia.description: Field 7: own item code = Producto.codigo = UBL cac:SellersItemIdentification/cbc:ID.

codigoSunat.description: Fields 8–9: UNSPSC code (catalog 1 of table 13), optional.

fecha.description: Field 10: date of the supporting document (DD/MM/AAAA in PLE).

tipoTabla10.description: Field 11: table 10; 00 for internal documents and adjustments.

serie.description: Field 12; '0' when the document has no series.

tipo.description: Direction of the movement; must be consistent with tipoOperacionTabla12 (R-61).

unidadMedidaTabla6.description: Field 16: table 6, derived from catalog 03 by the equivalence in tabla06.json (R-63).

cantidad.description: Fields 17/18: always positive here; exported as input (+) or output (−) according to tipo.

saldoFinal.description: Balance in units after this movement (R-65).

estadoOperacion.description: Field 19: 1 current period, 8 omitted from a previous period, 9 modifies a previous-period entry.
